class.name: MultiplayerSimulationClock
class.brief_description: Maintains simulation and delayed presentation timelines for multiplayer games.
class.description: [MultiplayerSimulationClock] tracks a local fixed-rate simulation clock and the newest observed server tick. When a server tick is observed, the presentation timeline starts [member interpolation_delay_ticks] behind it and advances continuously until the next server tick is received. Repeated or stale server ticks do not reset the current presentation phase.

method.name: advance
method.description: Advances the local clock and the presentation phase by [param delta] seconds. Returns the number of complete local simulation ticks advanced.

method.name: get_local_tick
method.description: Returns the current local simulation tick.

method.name: get_observed_server_tick
method.description: Returns the newest observed server tick, or [code]-1[/code] before a server tick is observed.

method.name: get_render_fraction
method.description: Returns the fractional progress from [method get_render_tick] toward the following tick.

method.name: get_render_tick
method.description: Returns the integral delayed presentation tick.

method.name: get_render_tick_time
method.description: Returns the delayed presentation time in ticks, including the current fractional phase.

method.name: get_tick_delta
method.description: Returns the duration of one simulation tick in seconds.

method.name: observe_server_tick
method.description: Observes a server tick. Only ticks newer than the current observation re-anchor the presentation phase.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears the local clock, server observation, and presentation phase.

method.name: set_local_tick
method.description: Sets the local simulation tick and clears its fractional accumulator.

members.member: Number of ticks by which presentation trails the latest observed server tick.
